recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group wants a new formal grammar for _has beyond FHIR-14957 and the later published search-page clarifications.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core search issue asking to specify reverse chaining search syntax using _has and eliminate confusion from mixed Observation:patient and Observation:subject examples.
initial_application: Jira comments cite svn revision 13397. Git commit 7067af22bc923ce4ae990f3c02b0d32252e1f546 (git-svn build@13397) applied the issue by changing the reverse-chaining OR and repeated _has examples from Observation:subject to Observation:patient.
additional_context: The current active source/search.html Reverse Chaining section is linked from the search page contents and from the Resource-_has SearchParameter summary. Later published search-page issues expanded/refined the same section: FHIR-20474 added the chained-search example, FHIR-34162 corrected the nested AuditEvent example to use agent, and FHIR-26886 added modifier caution with alternatives. Exact FHIR-14957 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current Reverse Chaining section consistently uses _has:Observation:patient:..., explains the roles of the resource type, reference search parameter, and criteria search parameter in prose, and includes basic, OR/repeated, nested, chained-search, and modifier-guidance examples. A new syntax restatement would be redundant with the accepted current wording.

related_jiras.note: Added the current example showing _has inside a chained search, expanding reverse-chaining examples after FHIR-14957.

Added guidance that reverse-chained search parameters are not intended to work with modifiers and points to named queries or _filter.
